title: ME60228: Heat Exchanger Design
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to heat exchangers; types, applications, materials, specification
and selection. Review of fluid mechanics and heat transfer, two-phase flow;
correlations. Methodology for thermal design of heat exchangers. Rating and
sizing problems. Pressure drop calculations. Shell and tube equipment; flow
induced vibration; standards: TEMA. Design consideration for plate type
devices; regenerators; condensers and boilers; cooling towers and heat pipes.
Heat exchanger fouling. Enhancement of heat transfer. Compact heat exchangers.
Optimization of heat exchangers; modelling and commercial codes.
